title: ReviewSense: Cluster-Guided Evidence Selection for Actionable Review-to-Advice Generation
abstract: arXiv:2510.16466v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Customer reviews are a rich but weakly structured source of operational feedback. We study ReviewSense, a cluster-guided evidence-selection workflow that converts review corpora into action-oriented advice for human decision support. Reviews are embedded with a sentence transformer, grouped by iterative cosine-similarity clustering with threshold decay, and reduced to compact evidence before Large Language Model (LLM) generation. Evaluating on dental and healthcare service reviews with expert judgment of actionability and annotator-based theme alignment, we find that a single central representative preserves the dominant cluster theme in 77.3% of cases but only 60.6% of secondary themes: central evidence captures main issues more reliably than minority concerns. translated_title: ReviewSense：面向可操作评论到建议生成的聚类引导证据选择
translated_abstract: 顾客评论是一种丰富但结构化程度较低的业务反馈来源。我们研究了ReviewSense，这是一个聚类引导的证据选择工作流，可将评论语料库转化为面向行动的建议，以支持人类决策。评论通过句子转换器进行嵌入，通过带有阈值衰减的迭代余弦相似度聚类进行分组，并在大型语言模型（LLM）生成之前被压缩为紧凑的证据。在牙科和医疗服务评论上进行评估，采用专家对可操作性的判断以及基于标注者的主题对齐，我们发现单个中心代表在77.3%的情况下能保留聚类的主导主题，但仅能保留60.6%的次要主题：中心证据比少数关注点更能可靠地捕捉主要问题。与固定生成器的LLM基线相比，五个聚类代表所生成的建议最接近专家建议，同时仅使用原始评论上下文的一小部分……
tldr: ReviewSense通过句子嵌入和阈值衰减的迭代余弦聚类来筛选代表性证据，将顾客评论转化为可操作建议，实验表明五个聚类代表生成的建议最接近专家推荐且仅使用少量原始评论上下文。
en_tdlr: ReviewSense converts customer reviews into actionable advice via sentence embedding and iterative cosine-similarity clustering for evidence selection, showing that five cluster representatives yield advice closest to expert recommendations while using only a fraction of the raw-review context.
